blocks.html: In celebration of World Animal Day, Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club in partnership with Pet Lovers Center, Manila East Veterinary Care, Elanco, Bayopet, and Advantix, will host the Second of the four-part series of Pet Konsulta, entitled: “Journey to Responsible Pet Ownership: Proper Pet Nutrition”.

Pet Konsulta is a virtual pet talk where fur-parents can learn more about their pet’s overall health and well-being and at the same ask or consult the vet for free. The upcoming virtual event on October 4, 3pm, will tackle cats and dogs’ nutrition focusing on basic nutritional requirements, food types, food diet guidelines, and prescription diets.

Pet owners will be delighted to know that apart for the pet talk and free online vet consultation, they also get the chance to win exciting prizes by just participating in the fun games especially prepared for them.

Tune in and watch Pet Konsulta via Facebook live at Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club and Pet Lover Center’s Facebook Pages! Like and follow Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club on Facebook for more updates: https://www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMallsHappyPetsClub/
